meta.description: Vendor/tool claims decomposed into evidence requirements, ASI mappings, benchmark suggestions, and validation status.

claims.title: MCP runtime security and tool-call governance
claims.claim: The tool can help discover, govern, or enforce security controls for MCP tools and agent runtime tool calls.
required_evidence: Official product documentation showing MCP/tool support
Runtime policy enforcement example or integration guide
Audit log or telemetry output for tool calls
Benchmark result for descriptor poisoning or over-permissioned tool use
claims.confidence_rule: High only when vendor docs and benchmark-backed evidence are both present.

claims.title: Agentic red-team evaluation
claims.claim: The tool supports adversarial evaluation of multi-step agents, goal drift, prompt injection, tool misuse, or multi-agent failure scenarios.
required_evidence: Attack library or evaluator documentation
Multi-turn or agent workflow support
Report format aligned to ASI/OWASP risks
Sample CI/CD integration or benchmark result
claims.confidence_rule: High when attack cases can be reproduced against a demo agent.

claims.title: RAG and memory protection
claims.claim: The tool can detect, prevent, or monitor memory/context poisoning, vector-store leakage, or sensitive-data exposure in retrieved context.
required_evidence: RAG/memory integration docs
Sensitive data or prompt-carrier detection docs
Tenant isolation or provenance controls
Benchmark result for cross-tenant memory bleed
claims.confidence_rule: High when both provenance controls and benchmark evidence are available.

claims.title: Agent identity and non-human identity governance
claims.claim: The tool can govern agent identities, delegated credentials, scoped tokens, or privilege boundaries.
required_evidence: NHI/agent identity documentation
Scoped credential or token lifecycle support
Per-action authorization or approval workflow
Audit trail for delegated identity use
claims.confidence_rule: High when the tool demonstrates scoped credentials and per-action auditability.

claims.title: Secure coding agent sandbox and RCE prevention
claims.claim: The tool helps prevent unexpected code execution, malicious package installation, or unsafe coding-agent behavior.
required_evidence: Sandbox or execution isolation documentation
Dependency/package provenance checks
Pre-execution code validation or policy gate
RCE-style benchmark result
claims.confidence_rule: High only when sandbox behavior can be tested and audited.
